description: Edwards Lifesciences Corporation is the leading global structural heart innovation company, driven by a passion to improve patient lives, and through breakthrough technologies, world-class evidence and meaningful partnerships with clinicians and healthcare stakeholders its employees are inspired by its patient-focused culture to deliver life-changing innovations. It has been a leader in its field for over six decades, and since its founder, Miles Lowell Edwards, first dreamed of using engineering to address diseases of the human heart it has steadily built a company on the premise of imagining, building and realizing a better future for patients. Its innovative work encompasses both surgical and transcatheter therapies, and its unique portfolio of repair and replacement technologies for aortic, mitral, tricuspid and pulmonic heart valves provides a broad set of treatment options, with transcatheter aortic heart valves first commercialized in Europe in 2007, in the United States in 2011 and in Japan in 2013.
